fact: Test-only strengthening is proven non-vacuous by running the new test against a deliberately broken copy of the production file in a scratch dir (never the repo file) and showing it fails while the old test passed.
recommendation: For every fix, record RED against the pre-fix code or a broken scratch copy, then GREEN; never mutate the repo file to demonstrate RED.
